issues.problem: Story named the archer 'Geng Ying'; the standard text of 战国策·楚策四 and school editions have 更羸 (Gēng Léi).
issues.action: Changed the name to Geng Lei; rest of the story checked against the source and kept.

issues.problem: Context 6 '他……弄得草木皆兵' left 弄得 without a natural object.
issues.action: Changed to 弄得自己草木皆兵.

issues.problem: Contexts 1, 3, 4 and 5 could equally take 孤注一掷 (set cy461), and 4 was the stock frame for 背水一战; they showed staking everything, not cutting off your own retreat.
issues.action: Rewrote 1 and 3 to stress no way back; replaced 4 (cancelling the ticket home) and 5 (deleting gaming accounts to finish a thesis) with deliberate destruction of one's own retreat; English updated.

issues.problem: Context 2 '有点愚公移山的劲头，每天学一点' could be filled by 持之以恒 (set cy415).
issues.action: Rewrote it around a huge task done bit by bit: 像愚公移山一样，今天背一点，明天再背一点.
